items.title: Shree Cement's Q4 profit down 4.3% to Rs 532 crore; FY26 revenue up 7% to Rs 19,907 crore
items.description: The company had posted a net profit of Rs 555.98 crore in the year-ago period, according to a regulatory filing from the Bangur family-promoted Shree Cement

items.title: Air India board to meet Thursday; CEO appointment, financials likely on agenda
items.description: The meeting assumes significance against the backdrop of the Tata Group-owned airline facing significant headwinds, including higher jet fuel costs, due to the West Asia conflict.

items.title: Valmo’s share of Meesho volumes falls to 50% from peak of 65%
items.description: Meesho has invested around Rs 200 crore in scaling up Valmo, a company spokesperson told Moneycontrol. The moderation comes months after Meesho’s logistics arm surpassed Delhivery in e-commerce order volumes.

items.title: Uber beats on bookings outlook in sign of growing US demand
items.description: The ride-hailing service guided total gross bookings to between $56.25 billion and $57.75 billion for the three-month period ending in June, while analysts on average looked for $56.23 billion

items.title: United Breweries plans actions to mitigate Rs 500 crore cost impact of West Asia war
items.description: Company flags Rs 400-500 crore cost impact due to ongoing West Asia war, plans to mitigate by pricing action, increasing production

items.title: Dal gosht out, healthy bowls in: Restaurants tweak menus as LPG costs bite
items.description: Prices of commercial LPG cylinders were hiked for a third time earlier this month, taking costs up to over Rs 3,000 for a 19-kg cylinder

items.title: Shoppers Stop swings to Q4 loss on muted discretionary spending
items.description: The Mumbai-based retailer reported a net loss of 163.5 million rupees ($1.72 million) for the three months ended March 31, compared with a profit of 19.9 million rupees a year earlier

items.title: India smartphone supplies to decline 10-12% in 2026, Vivo tops Q1 chart, says CMR
items.description: Apple shipments in India increased 6 per cent YoY and 9 per cent market share during the reported quarter.

items.description: The statement further said the project will be jointly implemented by Deendayal Port Authority (DPA) and Cochin Shipyard Limited (CSL), with a combined investment of Rs 1,570 crore

items.title: Zee sues Nykaa over alleged copyright misuse of songs on Instagram reels
items.description: In an April 3 lawsuit filed in the Delhi High Court, Zee argued it has a licensing agreement with Meta Platforms that allows individuals to use its music in Instagram posts for non-commercial use, but said Nykaa had used several of Zee's copyrighted songs in reels to promote products to millions of followers.

items.title: AvenuesAI charts a 'Liability-Light' path in credit, scouting NBFCs for minority stakes
items.description: A recent joint ICRA-ASSOCHAM report projects India's credit growth at INR 25-26 trillion for FY2026, reflecting a year-on-year expansion of 13.7%-14.3%.
